concepts.name: rom
concepts.definition: A game file or multi-file game folder on disk under a platform's folder in the library, tracked as a Rom row with its metadata, and hidden from users by visibility rules.

concepts.name: platform
concepts.definition: A gaming system (console, handheld, computer or arcade) whose folder in the library holds its roms and firmware, matched to metadata providers by its slug.

concepts.name: firmware
concepts.definition: A BIOS or system file a platform's emulator needs, stored in the platform's firmware folder and linked to that platform.

concepts.name: library
concepts.definition: The folder tree on disk that RomM scans: one folder per platform, each holding roms and firmware, in one of the supported layouts.

concepts.name: scan
concepts.definition: The background task that walks the library, creates or updates platforms, roms and firmware, and fetches their metadata from the enabled providers.

concepts.name: collection
concepts.definition: A user-defined group of roms, either a hand-picked list, a smart collection built from saved filters, or a virtual collection derived from metadata.

concepts.name: save
concepts.definition: A game save file a user uploaded or synced for one rom, owned by that user and optionally tracked per device.

concepts.name: screenshot
concepts.definition: An image of a rom captured by a user during play, owned by that user; metadata provider screenshots are rom media, not this concept.

concepts.name: device
concepts.definition: A client a user registered (a handheld, a frontend app, RetroArch) that syncs saves and play sessions with RomM, identified by a fingerprint.
